data.fund_type: An open ended debt scheme predominantly investing in AA and below rated corporate bonds (excluding AA+ rated corporate bonds). A relatively high interest rate risk and moderate credit risk
data.investment_objective: To generate accrual income and capital appreciation by investing in debt securities of varying maturities across the credit spectrum. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved
data.asset_allocation: Corporate debts: Min 80% Max 100% Debt and Money Market Instruments: Min.0% Max. 35%
data.benchmark: Nifty Credit Risk Bond Index B-II
data.exit_load: If units are redeemed/ switched-out on or before 1 year from the date of allotment - 1%. If units are redeemed / switched-out after 1 year from the date of allotment - Nil.
